source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: When the Doom Scythe picks a target for the heavy death ray, the enemy player chooses one outcome. The target can stand firm. Or it can duck for cover. Against a unit that stands firm, the ray scores Critical Hits on unmodified rolls to Hit of 5+. If the unit ducks, its models take −1 on their [Hit rolls](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls). That penalty expires as your next [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase) starts.

detail.trigger: each instance of targeting an enemy unit with heavy death ray

duck for cover.duration: until start of controller next Shooting phase
